task_description: GitHub issue #1401: reconcile the furniture/furnished/is_furnished payload schema across Qdrant setup paths and runtime filter producers. Two distinct collections coexist: (A) document/CSV pipeline (gdrive_documents_bge[_scalar|_binary]) where data lives under metadata.* and the writer (src/ingestion/chunker.py + src/ingestion/indexer.py) already emits metadata.furnished BOOL — but telegram_bot/setup_qdrant_indexes.py creates a dead metadata.furniture KEYWORD index, FilterExtractor produces a `furniture: "Есть"` string filter, and QueryAnalyzer's SYSTEM_PROMPT instructs the LLM to emit the same broken key — so any furniture-related filter against the document/CSV collection silently misses; (B) the standalone apartments collection where everything is already consistently top-level is_furnished BOOL and needs no changes. Decision: canonical metadata.furnished BOOL for collection (A), top-level is_furnished BOOL for collection (B). Implementation: realign collection (A) index creator + runtime filter producers + tests + docs/QDRANT_STACK.md, leave collection (B) untouched, document the migration path for deployments that already have a dead metadata.furniture keyword index.

verification.summary: Final verification on branch fix/1401-furniture-furnished-schema (HEAD 64d4af7, 2 commits on top of dev@f3a6bfb). Focused regression set: 151 passed in 2.39s for the 5 issue-relevant test files. Lint: `uv run ruff check telegram_bot/ src/ tests/unit/services/ scripts/` -> All checks passed!. Full fast lane: 7 failed, 6943 passed, 1 skipped, 192 warnings in 69.59s — the 7 failures are the exact pre-existing list captured in FEAT-001 baseline (test_ingestion_cocoindex.py::test_main_without_args_exits_with_usage, ::test_main_ingest_dir_without_path_exits, ::test_main_unknown_command_exits; test_docker_static_validation.py::test_compose_dev_config_renders, ::test_compose_dev_config_renders_with_full_profile; test_check_markdown_links.py::test_current_repository_markdown_links_are_valid; test_dialogs_fsm_coverage.py::test_every_declared_state_is_referenced_by_a_dialog) — pass count grew by exactly 8 (6935 -> 6943) matching the 8 new tests added by this change, confirming no regression. Cross-check sweep `rg 'metadata\.furniture|filters["furniture"]'` returns only intentional hits (regression-guard test asserting non-creation, docs/QDRANT_STACK.md migration note). Test quality reviewed end-to-end: every new and modified test exercises the real production code path via either the real class (FilterExtractor, detect_filter_sensitive_query) or by mocking only the I/O boundary (QdrantClient, BotConfig, mirroring the existing tests/unit/scripts/test_apartments_setup_collection.py harness); the prompt test asserts on the literal SYSTEM_PROMPT constant. Each test would fail if the production change were reverted. Skipped per `verify:repo-only` label and `.kiro/steering/agent-workflow.md`: docker compose build/up, tests/smoke/, tests/integration/, tests/e2e/, live Qdrant/Redis/Postgres connectivity.
